H7552J.name: Rakem
H7552J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7552J.brief: Son of Sheresh, of the tribe of Manasseh
H7552J.short: Rakem was a son of Sheresh, from the tribe of Manasseh.

H7505.name: Raphu
H7505.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7505.brief: Father of Palti, a spy sent by Moses
H7505.short: Raphu was the father of Palti, one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

H7552I.name: Rekem
H7552I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7552I.brief: Son of Hebron, of the tribe of Judah
H7552I.short: Rekem was a son of Hebron, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H7552G.name: Rekem
H7552G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7552G.brief: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites
H7552G.short: Rekem was one of the five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

H7501.name: Rephael
H7501.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7501.brief: A gatekeeper of the temple during David's reign
H7501.short: Rephael was one of the gatekeepers of the temple during the reign of King David.

H7506.name: Rephah
H7506.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7506.brief: Son of Beriah, of the tribe of Asher
H7506.short: Rephah was a son of Beriah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H7509G.name: Rephaiah
H7509G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7509G.short: Rephaiah was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

H7509H.name: Rephaiah
H7509H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7509H.brief: A Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites
H7509H.short: Rephaiah was a Simeonite leader who led an attack against the Amalekites during the time of Hezekiah.

H7509I.name: Rephaiah
H7509I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7509I.brief: Son of Tola, of the tribe of Issachar
H7509I.short: Rephaiah was a son of Tola, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar.

H7509J.name: Rephaiah
H7509J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7509J.brief: Son of Hur, who helped repair Jerusalem's wall
H7509J.short: Rephaiah was the son of Hur and ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, who helped repair a section of the city wall.

H7566.name: Resheph
H7566.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7566.brief: Son of Beriah, of the tribe of Asher
H7566.short: Resheph was a son of Beriah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H7526G.name: Rezin
H7526G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7526G.brief: King of Aram (Syria) during the reign of Ahaz
H7526G.short: Rezin was the king of Aram (Syria) who allied with Pekah, king of Israel, against Ahaz, king of Judah.

H7526H.name: Rezin
H7526H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7526H.brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants (Nethinim)
H7526H.short: Rezin was the ancestor of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H7525.name: Rizia
H7525.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7525.brief: Son of Ulla, of the tribe of Asher
H7525.short: Rizia was a son of Ulla, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H7532.name: Rizpah
H7532.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H7532.brief: Concubine of Saul; mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth
H7532.short: Rizpah was a concubine of King Saul and the mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth, who were executed by the Gibeonites.

H7586G.name: Saul
H7586G.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H7586G.brief: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel
H7586G.short: Saul was the first king of Israel, anointed by the prophet Samuel, who initially followed God but later disobeyed and was rejected as king.

H7586J.name: Shaul
H7586J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7586J.short: Shaul (or Joel) was a Levite descended from Kohath, as listed in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

H7586I.name: Shaul
H7586I.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7586I.brief: King of Edom from Rehoboth on the Euphrates
H7586I.short: Shaul, from Rehoboth on the Euphrates, was a king of Edom who reigned after Samlah and before Baal-hanan.

H7586H.name: Shaul
H7586H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7586H.brief: Son of Simeon, grandson of Jacob
H7586H.short: Shaul, the son of Simeon, was the grandson of Jacob and is listed among the descendants who went to Egypt with Jacob.

H7594.name: Sheal
H7594.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7594.brief: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
H7594.short: Sheal was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

H7597A.name: Shealtiel
H7597A.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7597A.brief: Grandfather of Zerubbabel, descendant of David
H7597A.short: Shealtiel, the grandfather of Zerubbabel, was a descendant of David and played a significant role in the rebuilding of the temple after the Babylonian exile.

H7557.name: Rakkath
H7557.brief: City on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee
H7557.short: Tiberias (Rakkath), a city on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, near where Jesus fed the five thousand (<ref="Josh. 19:35; Jhn.6.23">Josh. 19:35; Jhn.6.23</ref>).

H7542.name: Rakkon
H7542.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Dan
H7542.short: Rakkon was a town mentioned in the description of the territory allocated to the tribe of Dan in the Promised Land.

H7552H.name: Rekem
H7552H.short: Rekem was a city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin (<ref="Jos. 18:27">Jos. 18:27</ref>).

H7508.name: Rephidim
H7508.short: Rephidim was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Sinai (<ref="Exo. 17:1, 8; 19:2; Num. 33:14, 15">Exo. 17:1, 8; 19:2; Num. 33:14, 15</ref>).

H7530.name: Rezeph
H7530.short: Rezeph was a city conquered by the Assyrians, mentioned in a letter from the Assyrian king to Hezekiah (<ref="2Ki. 19:12; Isa. 37:12">2Ki. 19:12; Isa. 37:12</ref>).

H7575.name: Rithmah
H7575.short: Rithmah was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Canaan (<ref="Num. 33:18-19">Num. 33:18-19</ref>).
